payload.title: compute_eval_window_superiority substitutes the instant of the look for a missing EVAL_WINDOW anchor and still runs the paired comparison, against the reader's own contract and ruling 1, so an absent or unreadable anchor is reported as a shortage of discordant pairs
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_superiority.py:98-107 (entered is None becomes window_start=utc_now_datetime() and compare_eval_windows runs anyway)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:204-210 (the reader returns None for a chain that is not in EVAL_WINDOW or whose stamp cannot be read, and its docstring says the caller must not invent an anchor)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_lifecycle.py:136 (a row without recorded_at is stored as '' in a lawful chain, which parse_utc_stamp turns into None)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:157-178 (parse_utc_stamp: None is returned so each caller must decide, not inherit a default)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_policy.py:1071 (min_discordant_pairs is at least 1, so a comparison with zero pairs can never pass)
aria-kernel/tests/test_sequential_gain_test.py:1189-1197 (the test pins the substituted instant and the insufficient_evidence verdict)
aria-kernel/tests/test_sequential_gain_test.py:1224-1238 (a forged chain is pinned to the same substituted anchor)
payload.rule_violated: F1.8a SPEC ruling 1 (no anchor: the comparison 'does not run', fail closed) and the docstring of eval_window_entered_at ('The caller must not invent an anchor'); CLAUDE.md root-cause rule against defensive fallbacks that hide the missing upstream fact.
payload.notes: An entity that is not in EVAL_WINDOW, or whose EVAL_WINDOW entry row carries a recorded_at that does not parse (a hand-appended row, or a row without the stamp that _replay coerces to ''), gets anchor None from eval_window_entered_at. compute_eval_window_superiority then anchors the paired test at the instant of the look, finds no run dated at or after that instant, and returns window.verdict insufficient_evidence with reason 'need 6 discordant pairs, have 0' and window_start equal to the time of the look. Promotion is refused (the gate fails closed because pairs are 0 and the minimum is at least 1), but the proof names a missing anchor as a shortage of evidence and records a fabricated window_start; an entity whose entry stamp is unreadable stays in EVAL_WINDOW for good (a lawful chain enters each state once) with a diagnosis that points at the wrong cause. Read from the code; not reachable through record_transition, which always stamps with utc_now. Close condition: compute_eval_window_superiority returns passed False with a named reason (for example no_eval_window_entry) and makes zero calls to compare_eval_windows when eval_window_entered_at returns None; the two GateTests above are rewritten to assert that reason and a spy call count of zero, and _replay keeps an absent recorded_at as an absent value (or refuses the chain) instead of manufacturing ''. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
